technical.summary: Mixed signals with strong long-term structure but overbought short-term conditions and diverging momentum indicators suggest caution on immediate entry.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 14 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Fear-driven market sentiment (31 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buying opportunity, but stale congressional data (605+ days old) and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted curve, VIX 90.4 crisis level, rising USD, imminent CPI event) creates severe headwinds for industrials; earnings binary in 14 days compounds risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200 EMA with supertrend bullish and OBV accumulation, plus fear-zone contrarian setup, offers structural long-term support despite near-term overbought conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX 90.4 crisis, inverted yield curve, rising USD), imminent earnings binary in 14 days, overbought technicals with bearish momentum divergence (MACD, Stoch cross, Williams %R), and zero fundamental/smart money conviction create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Already holding AOS with 18 existing Industrials positions creates dangerous sector concentration; macro environment (VIX 90.4, inverted curve, rising USD) and imminent earnings binary (14 days) make swing entry high-risk regardless of contrarian sentiment.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 14 days combined with overbought technicals (Stoch bearish cross, MACD negative histogram, Williams %R overbought) and zero smart money/insider conviction creates binary downside risk in already-stressed macro environment.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Existing AOS position plus 18 Industrials holdings (58% of portfolio) creates unacceptable concentration risk; skip new entry and consider trimming existing exposure before earnings.
